title: A novel heteroleptic Cu(II)-phenanthroline-UDCA complex as lipoxygenase inhibitor and ER-stress inducer in cancer cell lines.
authors: Masuri, Sebastiano; Moran, Lukas; Vessela, Tereza; Cadoni, Enzo; Cabiddu, Maria Grazia; Pecinka, Lukas; Gabrielova, Viktorie; Meloni, Francesca; Havel, Josef; Vanhara, Petr; Pivetta, Tiziana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜(II)-菲咯啉-UDCA复合物作为脂氧合酶抑制剂及癌细胞ER应激诱导剂，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-酶互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A new heteroleptic copper(II) compound named C0-UDCA was prepared by reaction of [Cu(phen)(2)(OH(2))](ClO(4))(2) (C0) with the bile ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA). The resulting compound is able to inhibit the lipoxygenase enzyme showing more efficacy than the precursors C0 and UDCA. Molecular docking simulations clarified the interactions with the enzyme as due to allosteric modulation. The new complex shows antitumoral effect on ovarian (SKOV-3) and pancreatic (PANC-1) cancer cells at the Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) level by activating the Unfolded Protein Response. In particular, the chaperone BiP, the pro-apoptotic protein CHOP and the transcription factor ATF6 are upregulated in the presence of C0-UDCA. The combination of Intact Cell MALDI-MS and statistical analysis have allowed us to discriminate between untreated and treated cells based on their mass spectrometry fingerprints.
abstract_zh: 通过[Cu(phen)(2)(OH(2))](ClO(4))(2)（C0）与胆汁熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）反应制备了一种新型杂配铜(II)化合物，命名为C0-UDCA。所得化合物能够抑制脂氧合酶，其效力高于前体C0和UDCA。分子对接模拟阐明了与酶的相互作用归因于变构调节。该新复合物在卵巢癌（SKOV-3）和胰腺癌（PANC-1）细胞中通过激活未折叠蛋白反应，在内质网（ER）水平表现出抗肿瘤效应。特别是，在C0-UDCA存在下，伴侣蛋白BiP、促凋亡蛋白CHOP和转录因子ATF6均上调。完整细胞MALDI-MS与统计分析相结合，使我们能够根据其质谱指纹图谱区分未处理和处理的细胞。
